reason: The SDK dropped the `ExecuteWithOrigin` benchmark (paritytech/polkadot-sdk#7889), so the bencher has nothing to measure; the instruction keeps an unpayable weight, i.e. it stays unusable on Kreivo.
Kreivo accepts no teleports (`IsTeleporter = ()`), so the benchmark cannot run; `ReceiveTeleportedAsset` must stay unusable.
Kreivo teleports nothing (`XcmTeleportFilter = Nothing`, `teleportable_asset_and_dest` is `None`), so the benchmark cannot run; `teleport_assets` must stay unusable.
